$comment: Known, intended differences between the Figma library and the code. Every entry says why; anything not listed here is drift. Keys are Component.prop for props and file names for code-only components.

figmaOnlyProps.Avatar.type: Code picks image or initials from whether src loads; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Checkbox.checked: Base UI's checked and indeterminate props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.CommandMenu.view: Which page is open is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.CommandMenu.preview: Code shows the pane when an item has preview content; Figma toggles it.
figmaOnlyProps.TypingIndicator.indicator: Code shows a person's indicator from data when they're the only one typing; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.MessageListMessage.type: Code picks first, continuation, system or deleted from grouping rules and message data, not a prop.
figmaOnlyProps.MessageListDivider.unread: Code draws the unread divider above the message named by unreadFrom.
figmaOnlyProps.DataTable.selection: In code the selection is the table's rowSelection state, from useDataTable; Figma shows each state as a variant.
figmaOnlyProps.DataTable.width: Code reads the container's width and switches at 32rem; Figma picks narrow by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.FloatingNavItem.type: Code makes an item text-only when it has no icon; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.StickerAvatar.shape: Code picks the shape from the image: a cut-out when its border is clear, round for a photo, initials with no image. Designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.RadioGroupItem.checked: Base UI checks the item whose value matches the group's value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Separator.orientation: Base UI's orientation prop, horizontal or vertical as here, not a fibo union.
figmaOnlyProps.Switch.checked: Base UI's checked and defaultChecked props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Slider.thumbs: Code draws one thumb per value passed; Figma picks one or two by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Pagination.position: Code disables Previous and Next from page and pageCount; designers pick first, middle or last by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.MenuCheckboxItem.checked: Base UI's checked and defaultChecked props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.MenuRadioItem.checked: Base UI checks the item whose value matches the radio group's value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Toast.type: The type is passed to toast.add() as data, not as a component prop.
figmaOnlyProps.FilterMenu.view: Which view shows is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.FilterMenuRow.kind: Code renders a field or an option row from its data; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.FilterMenuRow.checked: Code checks options and counts a field from the value; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.PixelSnail.size: size is keyof typeof SCALE in code, which the check cannot read; its options are sm, default and lg, as here.
figmaOnlyProps.Calendar.mode: A real prop, but declared once per branch of Calendar's discriminated union (single or range), which the drift parser doesn't read.
figmaOnlyProps.DatePickerTrigger.size: A real prop, typed FieldSize from lib/field-size.ts (sm, default), which the drift parser can't resolve across files.
figmaOnlyProps.Tabs.orientation: Base UI's Tabs orientation prop, passed through rather than declared in tabs.tsx.
figmaOnlyProps.ChatComposerFrame.draft: Code reads empty or filled from the draft itself; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.ChatComposerFrame/Minimal.draft: Code reads empty or filled from the draft itself; designers pick it by hand.

codeOnlyProps.input-group.align: InputGroupAddon's align, inline-start or inline-end; Figma turns each side on with startAddon and endAddon instead.
codeOnlyProps.reactions.position: Which viewport corner the floating bar pins to; Figma shows the bar on its own.
codeOnlyProps.annotated-text.tone: Figma keeps tone out of the variant set so it stays at ten marks rather than sixty; designers bind the mark's stroke to the tone token (foreground, muted-foreground or a status icon token) instead.

codeOnlyComponents.count: Count is figures in text, styled by the part it sits in; in Figma it is typed into that part's text layer, such as 99+ or +4.
